meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会作为主持人，让用户的不同 git 工作区或 PR 各自扮演一个“分支代理”，在共享聊天文件中轮流发言，比较各自变更，最终产出一个合并计划。Claude 负责召集、驱动轮次、总结，但不会自动执行 git 操作。
howto.when: 当用户要求 Claude 组织一次跨分支或 PR 的代码对比和合并规划时触发。典型场景：用户说“帮我开个站会”或“对比这些分支的变更”。

say.text: 帮我开个站会，对比最近4小时活跃的工作区。
say.note: Claude 会列出活跃工作区并开始轮次对话。

say.text: 对比 main 分支和 feature-x 分支，给出合并计划。
say.note: Claude 会手动指定分支并启动站会。

say.text: 看看我所有 PR 的变更，然后汇总一个合并方案。
say.note: Claude 会拉取 PR 列表并组织讨论。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a facilitator, turning each of the user's git worktrees or PRs into a 'branch agent' that chats in a shared file, compares changes, and produces a consolidation plan. Claude convenes, drives rounds, and summarizes, but does not execute git operations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to organize a cross-branch or cross-PR comparison and merge planning. Typical scenario: user says 'run a standup' or 'compare these branches'.

say_en.text: Run a standup for worktrees active in the last 4 hours.
say_en.note: Claude lists active worktrees and starts rounds.

say_en.text: Compare main and feature-x branches and give a merge plan.
say_en.note: Claude manually specifies branches and starts standup.

say_en.text: Review all my open PRs and summarize a consolidation plan.
say_en.note: Claude fetches PRs and organizes discussion.
